verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a REST API (with OpenAPI spec confirmed live), a TypeScript SDK, and CLI, with bearer-token authentication, letting AI-native users drive agent creation, tool/model configuration, and monitoring programmatically. This is corroborated by an independently probed live openapi.json and llms.txt describing 'The API for Production-Grade Agents.' Missing for 10: independent third-party developer accounts of using the API/SDK in production (community evidence is mostly about UI/pricing, not API usage).
